notes.title: Historium VR Patch 1.10
notes.content:
[b]Additions:[/b]
Selection between 10 different languages. Language selection changes both the Voiceover and the text.
[list]
[*]Chinese
[*]English
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Dutch
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Numerous visual tweaks and fixes
[*]Fixed visual + audio fade effects in explorer scenes
[*]Fixed boat parcour in Dampoort scene to avoid the illusion of crashing
[*]Fixed music in menu not looping
[*]Fixed English pronounciation of Bruges
[/list]
